note: Constructed cases. Each starts from an annotated pair, applies a recorded list of edits to the chart, and overrides only the criteria those edits close. The case-level outcome is NOT written here: scripts/build_answer_key.py derives it by applying caliper.logic.roll_up to the base case's adjudicated criterion labels with these overrides applied. Every label therefore still traces to a human criterion judgement plus the pre-registered rollup rule. See protocol.md section 11.
terminology_note: Every code used below is lifted verbatim from the committed corpus, so nothing is invented: SNOMED 44054006 and 414545008 and LOINC 33914-3, 4548-4 and 38483-4 all already appear in data/patients/*.json. Supplied values are placed comfortably inside or outside the band, never on the boundary, except where the case is explicitly a near-miss.

cases.note: The eligible member of the 1be83f06 triple. cases.note: The eligible member of the f870c432 triple.
